research.title: Visual Surface Defect Classification
bullets: Prepared surface inspection images by checking defect annotations, standardizing image dimensions, and separating training and evaluation sets by source object.
Implemented a prescribed baseline using histogram of oriented gradients and a linear support vector machine, reviewing confusion matrices across defect categories.

research.title: Foreground Segmentation in Fixed-Camera Scenes
bullets: Organized fixed-camera image sequences, checked foreground masks for annotation inconsistencies, and applied the supplied sequence-level split for baseline evaluation.
Implemented frame differencing and threshold-based segmentation baselines, comparing predicted masks with annotations and inspecting errors caused by shadows and illumination changes.

projects.title: Color Histogram Baseline for Image Retrieval
bullets: Implemented a nearest-neighbor image retrieval baseline using normalized color histograms and distance calculations for ranking images against a query.
Evaluated retrieval rankings against category labels and inspected mismatched results to identify limitations from similar colors and differing object arrangements.

projects.title: Principal Component Baseline for Handwritten Character Recognition
bullets: Prepared grayscale character images through intensity normalization and flattening, fitting principal component analysis exclusively on the training partition.
Implemented nearest-neighbor classification on projected features, comparing it with raw-pixel classification and reviewing confusion between visually similar characters.
